newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales to total $980 mln for Sept 11.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales to total $980 mln for Sept 11.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total about $980 million in 29 offerings for September 10, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales for Wednesday are expected to total about $467.4 million in 15 offerings. The largest is a $115.2 million Wisconsin general obligation deal set for 1100 EDT.
Negotiated sales, depending on market conditions, could total $513 million in 14 offerings. The largest issue is expected to be a $134 million Broward County, Fla., issue through PaineWebber Inc.
Another $236 million of deals are on the Reuters possible negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters may decide to price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions.
